description: Converts a value between units of length, mass, volume (US and imperial), area, speed, time, digital data (KB vs KiB, bits vs bytes), energy, pressure and temperature. Accepts common abbreviations (km, lb, fl oz, mph, °F, GiB). US customary units are used for cup/pint/quart/gallon unless you say imperial.
name: convert_units
title: Unit converter
